theme_palette.description: App palette as #RRGGBB (or #RRGGBBAA). Any subset of keys may be sent; whatever is missing or unparseable keeps the shipped color. cardColors is ignored unless it has at least 5 valid entries, since Card.colorIndex is generated against that count.

multiplayer_enabled.description: Kill-switch for the multiplayer entry point. False hides the button; players already in a room are not ejected.

competition_enabled.description: Kill-switch for the competition/trophy entry point.

hints_enabled.description: Kill-switch for the hint button, single-player and multiplayer alike.

daily_puzzle_enabled.description: Kill-switch for the daily-puzzle/streak entry point. Depends on the generateDailyPuzzle scheduled Cloud Function being deployed — set to false here if the app ships before that backend is live.

min_supported_build.description: Builds with CFBundleVersion below this are blocked at launch behind UpdateRequiredView. 0 disables the gate. Raise this only to retire a genuinely broken build — it locks those users out until they update.

latest_recommended_build.description: Builds below this see a dismissible update banner on Home (HomeView). 0 disables it. Bump to the current App Store build on every release; must stay at or above min_supported_build.

update_message.description: Body copy on the update-required screen. Blank falls back to generic wording.

soft_update_message.description: Body copy on the dismissible soft-update banner. Blank falls back to generic wording.

multiplayer_lock_window.description: Seconds a player has to prove a solve after buzzing in. Clamped client-side to 3-60; anything outside that keeps the shipped 7.

multiplayer_miss_cooldown.description: Seconds a player waits after letting a lock window lapse. Clamped client-side to 0-120; anything outside that keeps the shipped 14.

competition_unlock_threshold.description: Signups needed before Competition Mode opens, and the target shown on the progress bar. Floored at 1 client-side, since a blank field parses as 0 and would open the mode instantly.

competition_force_unlock.description: Opens Competition Mode regardless of the signup count. Use to launch early, or set the threshold unreachably high plus this false to re-lock after launch.

rating_tiers.description: Tier bands over solo/ranked ratings. tiers: ascending floors (min 2); divisions per tier (1-6); demotionMargin: points under a floor before a drop; unrankedUntil: solo puzzles before a tier shows; placementMatches: ranked matches before one (0-50).

ranked_bots_enabled.description: Server-side: when a ranked player has waited ~ranked_bot_wait_seconds with no human available, match them against a roster bot (functions/src/ranked.ts). Off = players wait for humans only.

ranked_bot_wait_seconds.description: Server-side: centre of the wait before a bot is offered. Actual wait is gaussian around this (see ranked_bot_wait_jitter_seconds), clamped to 0.6x-1.9x. Clamped 5-120.

ranked_bot_wait_jitter_seconds.description: Server-side: standard deviation of the bot-offer wait, so it never lands on the same second twice. Clamped 0-60.

ranked_bot_target_win_rate.description: Server-side: how often a player rated the same as the bot should beat it. 0.5 is fair; lower makes bots slower. Clamped 0.1-0.9.

ranked_referrals_required.description: Per-player gate on Ranked (on top of competition_force_unlock / the signup threshold): how many friends a player must have referred before Ranked opens for them. 0 disables the gate. Negative values are treated as 0 client-side.

ranked_referral_gate_after_placement.description: true: new players play their placement matches (rating_tiers.placementMatches) without a referral; ranked_referrals_required then holds back the rank reveal and further Ranked play. false: the gate stands in front of the first match.

ranked_referral_gate_since.description: UTC day (yyyy-MM-dd) from which new accounts must meet ranked_referrals_required. Accounts created before this day are grandfathered into Ranked. Blank or unparseable gates everyone.
